At Mid Lakes Heating and Cooling, we want to make it easier to move forward with the solution that makes sense for your home and family. Financing is available for qualifying projects, and our team can help guide you through the process from your estimate to the online application.
Flexibility

settings.title: More Flexibility When Your Home Needs It

settings.editor: Some home improvements are planned months in advance. Others begin with an air conditioner that stops working on a hot Georgia afternoon or a comfort problem that can no longer be put off.
Financing gives eligible homeowners another way to manage a larger home-comfort expense without having to cover the entire cost upfront.
That means you can focus first on what your home needs, understand the recommended solution, and then decide which payment option makes the most sense for your household.
Our goal is simple: give you clear information and help make the process easier—not add more pressure to an already important decision.
Our lending partner
Mid Lakes HVAC partners with Service Finance to provide financing for qualifying home-comfort projects.
Available rates, terms, and promotional offers depend on the financing program and credit approval.
Here are the key details:

settings.editor: Process
We keep the process straightforward so you can focus on making the right decision for your home.
Tell us what’s going on with your home or what you’re hoping to improve.
Our team will evaluate your needs, explain the recommended solution, and provide pricing for the work.

settings.title: Decide Whether You’d Like to Finance

settings.editor: Once you know what the project involves and what it will cost, you can decide whether financing makes sense for your household.
If you’d like to explore it, just let your technician know.
The financing application is completed online through Service Finance.
You won’t have to navigate the process by yourself. Your Mid Lakes technician can help walk you through the application and point you toward the information you need.
If approved, review the available financing terms and choose the option that works for you.
Once your project details and payment arrangements are finalized, our team can move forward with scheduling your service.
Considerations
There’s no single right way to pay for a home-comfort project. For some families, financing simply provides more room to work with when a larger expense comes along.
Financing is simply another option. We’ll give you the information you need and let you decide what works best for your family.
It may help you:

icon_list.text: Spread the cost of a larger project over time
Avoid paying the full project cost upfront
Address an important comfort need sooner
Choose a solution based on what your home needs
Keep more flexibility in your household budget

Straight answers
A major HVAC or home-comfort expense can feel like a lot to navigate, especially when it wasn’t part of the plan.

As a family-owned and locally operated company, Mid Lakes HVAC believes in keeping things straightforward. We’ll help you understand what your home needs, explain the work clearly, and walk you through your options without unnecessary pressure.
And if you decide financing is the right fit, our team will be there to help you take the next step.

With 75+ years of combined team experience, licensed and insured service, free estimates, and a Parts & Labor Guarantee, you can feel confident about both the work being recommended and the local team standing behind it.
